title: M&M Financial leads midcaps on Q2 update

timeline.title: M&M Financial leads midcaps on Q2 update
timeline.line: Q2 disbursements rose 22% YoY to ₹16,490 cr; collection efficiency improved to 97%
more: Business assets are about ₹1,46,300 cr, up around 15% YoY
The liquidity chest is over ₹16,200 cr
Q2 results are due on October 21
